title: Evaluation Configuration and Runners
summary: This module provides configurations for various evaluation types and functions to run LLMs or chains against datasets, logging results to LangSmith. It supports both synchronous and asynchronous evaluation workflows with customizable evaluators.

nodes.label: Execute Synchronous Evaluation
nodes.title: Synchronous Dataset Evaluation
nodes.description: Orchestrates the synchronous execution of an LLM or chain across a dataset, applying evaluators and logging results to LangSmith.

nodes.label: Execute Asynchronous Evaluation
nodes.title: Asynchronous Dataset Evaluation
nodes.description: Orchestrates the asynchronous execution of an LLM or chain across a dataset, applying evaluators and logging results to LangSmith.

nodes.label: Manage Evaluation Run State
nodes.title: Evaluation Run State Manager
nodes.description: Stores and manages the state, configurations, and results for a dataset evaluation run, including callbacks and metrics collection.

nodes.label: Execute LLM/Chain for Example
nodes.title: LLM/Chain Example Executor
nodes.description: Executes a language model or chain for a single dataset example, handling inputs, callbacks, and potential errors during evaluation.

nodes.label: Configure Labeled Score Evaluation
nodes.title: Labeled Score Config
nodes.description: Defines settings for evaluators that score strings based on predefined labels.

nodes.label: Configure Labeled Criteria Evaluation
nodes.title: Labeled Criteria Config
nodes.description: Defines settings for evaluators that use an LLM to judge outputs against specific criteria, often with reference answers.

nodes.label: Configure Embedding Distance Evaluation
nodes.title: Embedding Distance Config
nodes.description: Defines settings for evaluators that measure similarity between texts using embedding distances and specified metrics.

nodes.label: Configure String Distance Evaluation
nodes.title: String Distance Config
nodes.description: Defines settings for evaluators that compare strings using various distance metrics like Levenshtein or Jaro-Winkler.

nodes.label: Configure QA Evaluation
nodes.title: QA Evaluation Config
nodes.description: Defines settings for evaluators that assess question-answering performance using an LLM and a prompt template.

nodes.label: Configure Context QA Evaluation
nodes.title: Context QA Evaluation Config
nodes.description: Defines settings for evaluators that assess context-based question-answering performance using an LLM and a prompt template.

nodes.label: Configure CoT QA Evaluation
nodes.title: CoT QA Evaluation Config
nodes.description: Defines settings for evaluators that assess Chain-of-Thought QA performance using an LLM and a prompt template.

nodes.label: Configure JSON Validity Evaluation
nodes.title: JSON Validity Config
nodes.description: Defines settings for evaluators that check if an output string represents valid JSON.

nodes.label: Configure Exact Match Evaluation
nodes.title: Exact Match Config
nodes.description: Defines settings for evaluators that check for exact string matches, with options for ignoring case, punctuation, or numbers.

nodes.label: Configure Regex Match Evaluation
nodes.title: Regex Match Config
nodes.description: Defines settings for evaluators that check if an output string matches a given regular expression.

nodes.label: LangSmith Client
nodes.title: LangSmith Platform Interface
nodes.description: An external client used to interact with the LangSmith platform for logging traces, feedback, and managing datasets.

nodes.label: LLM or Chain Constructor
nodes.title: Model/Chain Provider
nodes.description: A callable that constructs an instance of a Language Model (LLM) or a Chain for execution during evaluation.

nodes.label: Evaluation Configuration (RunEvalConfig)
nodes.title: Overall Evaluation Settings
nodes.description: An external configuration object that specifies which evaluators to run and their specific parameters for a dataset evaluation.

nodes.label: Dataset Example
nodes.title: Single Dataset Entry
nodes.description: A single input-output pair from a dataset, representing a test case for the LLM or chain.

nodes.label: Runnable Configuration
nodes.title: Execution Configuration
nodes.description: A configuration object for a runnable, including settings for callbacks, tags, and concurrency during execution.

nodes.label: Base Language Model
nodes.title: Core LLM Interface
nodes.description: The abstract base class for all language models, providing a standardized interface for LLM interactions.

nodes.label: Base Prompt Template
nodes.title: Core Prompt Template Interface
nodes.description: The abstract base class for prompt templates, used to format inputs for language models.

nodes.label: Embeddings Model
nodes.title: Text Embedding Generator
nodes.description: An interface for models that generate vector representations (embeddings) of text, used for similarity calculations.

groups.label: Evaluation Orchestration
groups.title: Evaluation Orchestration
groups.description: Manages the overall evaluation process, including dataset iteration, callback handling, and result aggregation.

groups.label: Core Execution Logic
groups.title: Core Execution Logic
groups.description: Handles the actual execution of the LLM or chain against individual examples, capturing outputs and errors.

groups.label: LLM-Based Evaluation Configs
groups.title: LLM-Based Evaluation Configurations
groups.description: Defines configurations for evaluation types that rely on a Language Model (LLM) for scoring or analysis.

groups.label: String/Embedding Evaluation Configs
groups.title: String and Embedding Evaluation Configurations
groups.description: Specifies parameters for evaluation types based on string comparisons, embedding distances, or JSON structure validation.

groups.label: External Interfaces
groups.title: External System Interfaces
groups.description: Represents external systems, data structures, and models that interact with the evaluation runners.
